verdict.rationale: Hatchet provides a local dev worker (`hatchet worker dev`) with hot-reload and a profiles system (`hatchet profile`) to manage/switch between multiple Hatchet instances or tenants, which lets an AI-native user run and test workflows locally or against a separate tenant instead of production. However, there's no explicit 'sandbox' or staging environment feature, no documented data-isolation guarantee, and no dedicated test-fixture/mocking tooling for workflows. missing for 10: a first-class sandbox/staging environment concept, explicit guarantee of production-data isolation, and independent hands-on confirmation of safe dev/test workflows.
